title: Native Windows provisioning downloads pinned tools again for each new lane tree
body: Follow-up evidence to cx-cacheatomic1: a separate Windows-native tree for the warm-cache witness reran vixen-native build.bat provision and downloaded Ninja 1.13.1 (1.8 MB) again, although the cold tree had just provisioned the same pinned version. Each C:\vixen-native\<lane> stores its own VIXEN/.win-native-toolchain/downloads payload. The second tree was required to measure shared ccache hits; provisioning should use a shared immutable version-and-hash keyed tool archive while keeping each tree pinned.

title: Native Windows GPU wrapper breaks grouped CTest filters
body: A valid CTest -R grouped alternation passed to tools/run-native-gpu-suite.bat failed in cmd.exe with ') was unexpected at this time.' before CTest started. Splitting the capture run into -R StoredSdf and -R SdfFilter passed. Preserve regex arguments safely across cmd.exe or expose a filter-file/PowerShell path.

title: Box queue identity RPC retries delay native job admission
body: The queued native GPU commands for StoredSdf and SdfFilter each saw identity RPC timeouts before payload start (10s and 21s, then a longer measured retry); the wrapper recovered and both test groups passed. Improve the queue identity RPC startup/health retry path so native jobs do not incur repeated pre-admission delays. Example: with-test-lock.sh --agent winvel2 --resource gpu --label winvel2:focused:sdffilter-vx11 -- env VIXEN_CAPTURE_ROOT=... tools/vixen-native.sh --lane winvel2 bat tools/run-native-gpu-suite.bat -R SdfFilter.
